correctness.rationale: For all integers n>=4, 1<=k<n/2 in a strict generic winding band ell/(2ell+1)<k/n<(ell+1)/(2ell+3), the known clique complex sphere has rank-one integral H_(2ell+1). Canonical n0=4ell+4,k0=2ell+1 gives a join of 2ell+2 copies of S^0; signed coordinate reflection has degree (-1)^(ell+1). Common large-cycle inclusions preserve reflection and, by Adamaszek–Adams Prop 4.9, are homotopy equivalences within the band. One-step rotation is contiguous to identity after inclusion K_(N,K)->K_(N,K+1), whose induced homology map is an isomorphism, so all rotations have degree +1. Rational homology of finite-group quotients equals invariants after barycentric subdivision: full dihedral quotient top Q exactly for odd ell. Independently enumerated fixed simplices with permutation signs for 93 action/cycle pairs across n=4..14, two reflection axes and one rotation per valid pair, all agreeing with claimed sign. Enumeration is corroboration, not infinite proof.
